stories.title: Raye leads 2027 Grammy nominations, followed by Rosalía, Ella Langley, Olivia Rodrigo and more
stories.summary: English singer-songwriter Raye, who is riding the success of her critically acclaimed album “This Music May Contain Hope,” is up for 11 awards, including record, song and album of the year.

stories.title: Robert Pattinson is named the 7th James Bond, taking over from Daniel Craig
stories.summary: The naming of Pattinson on Monday comes during the longest hiatus in 007 history and ends years of rampant speculation about who would inherit the role from Daniel Craig.

stories.title: Pope bids ‘hasta luego’ to his second homeland of Peru as he wraps up marathon South American trip
stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV wrapped up a marathon 12-day South American tour that tested his stamina after lung cancer surgery.

stories.title: Trump’s tariffs are unpopular, but they’ll be tough to repeal despite Democrats’ landslide win
stories.summary: The president will still have power to veto any legislation that repeals his import taxes or reins in his legal authority to impose them. And it’s unclear that enough Republicans would join Democrats in overriding his veto.

stories.title: Update: Glenn Highway partly reopens after collision near Fort Richardson, Anchorage police say
stories.summary: The southbound highway was closed near the Fort Richardson exit as drivers report a serious, multi-vehicle collision.

stories.title: Questions swirl around FAA’s new SMART AI system, though officials say no link to ground stop
stories.summary: Under the SMART system, a team of experts analyzes flight schedules, weather forecasts and hundreds of other streams of data, then the FAA’s command center relays them to air traffic controllers across the country for consideration.

stories.title: Letter: Alaska voters deserve more than ‘he qualified for the ballot’
Letter: Rep. Nick Begich should put his so-called support of veterans on the record
Opinion: Alaska’s citizen voting measure is the first step, and a constitutional amendment is the next
stories.summary: Legislators should advance a constitutional amendment that puts an explicit citizenship requirement before voters.

stories.title: Opinion: The way out of youth homelessness starts before the streets
stories.summary: Two upcoming Covenant House events offer Alaskans an opportunity to turn concern into prevention.
